client_brief:
Rebuild our insurance counter-card template and produce the district run

The printer who made Aldervale Mutual's counter cards has closed. We still have the press file and need a reusable production route, not a one-time approximation of the design.

Our producers leave these cards with clients at kitchen tables. The licence line and full disclosure must remain readable and verbatim. Please reconcile the active roster before deciding how many cards to produce.

Print run and reusable template: One 4 by 6 card per active producer, card count equal to the reconciled roster, binding name, license line, office and the full disclosure verbatim plus that producer's own plate. Accompanied by one single-card file per producer, named to the roster and identity-verified by opening it, and by proofs rendered at true print-resolution from the merged document. Produced by reverse-engineering the retired printer's press file into a live merge template, so the template and the record of how it was derived are handed back.

Portrait preparation: Fourteen self-submitted phone photographs brought to one skin rendering, one background value, one head size in frame and one crop logic, delivered at or below each source frame's dimensions with a per-producer parameter log and one line on why that producer differs from the others. Any producer who cannot be brought to the set is named rather than shipped near it. One set, not one portrait at several sizes.

The fourteen submitted portraits vary considerably. We need a consistent rendering, background value and head size, with anyone whose photograph cannot meet the standard named explicitly.

producer_headshots/ (14 frames, mixed dimensions, 900 to 4000 px on the long edge); countercard_2026_print.pdf; producer_roster_northern.csv; plan_rates_2027.csv; compliance_note.txt.

Please open the individual producer files as part of the identity check. Correct page count alone will not catch a portrait or filename attached to the wrong person.

The commission is budgeted at $1,400-$3,800 fixed. We have allowed 7 to 15 business days, including one technical proof and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

Alongside the finished work, we need a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and the normalised data and field-mapping record. Keep a clear record of the supplied files used, retained for reference, superseded and rejected. Approved source information remains authoritative. Record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and quality limits, and do not use an undeclared replacement or invented fact to conceal a source problem.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the recurring Upwork insurance-agency posting in which an agency marketing manager asks a freelancer to 'redesign our agent one-pager and build a slide deck our producers can actually present at the kitchen table', supplying a roster spreadsheet, a folder of agent headshots 'of wildly varying quality, everyone sent us whatever they had', and a PDF of the current printed card, with the standing requirement that everything come back 'editable so we can update rates and the disclosure ourselves without coming back to you'. Co-anchor: the Freelancer.com variable-data posting from a financial services office needing 'personalised counter cards, one per advisor, print ready, plus an individual PDF for each so we can reprint one at a time', worked from an existing printed card whose original designer is no longer reachable. Both real clients, their carrier and their compliance language are laundered to the fictional Aldervale Mutual. The ledger's STRENGTHEN verdict was correct that the original concept sat almost entirely on the authoring surface: the fuller commission this client genuinely has begins at fourteen phone-camera headshots and a retired printer's press file, runs through a regulated variable-data card run, and only then reaches the deck and the one-pager.

price_band_and_audience: Whole life and final expense at forty five to a hundred and eighty dollars a month, sold face to face to households aged thirty five to sixty with modest savings, whose stated motive is not wanting to leave a burden. The band is load-bearing in both directions. At this price and this motive the correct grammar is sober and plain: a muted institutional palette, generous white space, a benefit table that reads like a table rather than a graphic, one restrained accent used only to mark the recommended plan, and type that carries authority without announcing itself. Pushed upward into the gold-rule, deep-navy, serif-display register of a private wealth manager it misreads the buyer entirely and reads as a product they cannot afford. Pushed downward into a bright promotional layout with burst callouts and exclamation-weight headlines it reads as a direct-response mailer, which is exactly the register a regulated mutual's compliance desk rejects and exactly the register that makes a thirty five year old distrust a ninety-one year old carrier. A real posted commission of this shape runs 1,400 to 3,000 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.audience: Households aged 35 to 60 with modest savings, buying because they do not want to leave a burden. They trust plainness and distrust anything that reads like a sales pitch.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premiums run 45 to 180 dollars a month, drop in comparison irrelevant. A regulated mutual at a modest, accessible band, deliberately not a private wealth manager and not a discount direct response mailer.
brand_identity.typography: Type that carries authority without announcing itself. A traditional text serif for body and disclosures, a clean sans for labels and figures, one restrained accent used only to mark the recommended plan. Generous white space, tables that read like tables.
brand_identity.voice: Sober, plain and reassuring, written the way a trusted advisor speaks across a table. No exclamation, no urgency. Example line the brand would write: A whole life policy is a promise that holds its value, and the premium you start with is the premium you keep.

Producer headshots are self submitted from personal phones and vary widely. Compliance owns the disclosure language and updates it when a state changes its rules.
brand_identity.values: Nothing may read as an advertisement, and everything must survive the kitchen table. Compliance and honesty come before flourish, and the material should feel as dependable as the carrier behind it.

assets_supplied.kind: Self-submitted producer photographs, one per producer in the Northern district, taken on personal phones in branch offices and at home over about three weeks.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What came back came back from fourteen different phones in fourteen different offices."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Five producers stood against the branch's mid-grey painted wall in a charcoal or navy suit, so the shoulder line and the ground sit at nearly the same luminance and a knockout takes a bite out of the shoulder while reporting success and returning a plausible file. Two frames are small phone captures that cannot fill the card's photograph area at native scale, and one carries a partner bank's counter signage legible behind the producer.

assets_supplied.name: countercard_2026_print.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The retired printer's flat press PDF for the counter card, 4 by 6 inches portrait, fonts embedded, produced from a real page layout so it converts cleanly. Carries the producer name, the license line, the office line, the disclosure paragraph and a placed photograph.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The card our printer ran. We only have what went to press and she has closed."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The four printed copy blocks do not arrive as four addressable frames and which of them share a story with which is not predictable from the printed card, so some fields must be driven by ordered offset arithmetic inside a single flow. The disclosure sits in a fixed-measure frame sized in 2026 to the single sentence compliance used that year, and a frame like that does not spill: it simply stops rendering at its boundary.

assets_supplied.name: producer_roster_northern.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Export from the licensing system, one row per appointed producer in the Northern district, with columns for name, license line, office, state, disclosure text and a photo filename.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The fourteen for the Northern district, straight out of the licensing system."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three faults, none stated. One producer resigned in November and the export still carries her. Two producers are dually licensed in a second state and their disclosure cell holds a materially longer state-specific paragraph than the sentence the other twelve carry. And one row's photo column names a file nobody actually sent.

assets_supplied.name: plan_rates_2027.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The actuarial rate table for the three plans, by issue age band and by coverage amount, as the pricing desk exports it.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What a premium buys, by age. This is the file the rate infographic has to be true to."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two of the three plans are quoted as a rate per thousand dollars of coverage while the third is quoted as a flat monthly premium, and no column anywhere says which is which. Laid straight into one table or one chart axis the three plans present three different kinds of number as though they were comparable.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which of the fourteen separations actually holds at the edge. Five producers stood against the branch's mid-grey painted wall in a charcoal or navy suit, and where shoulder and ground sit at nearly the same value the separation bites into the shoulder or eats the collar while the call returns success and a perfectly plausible file. It is invisible at the scale an agent inspects at, because a missing sliver of a dark shoulder against a pale card ground only resolves as a chewed edge at print size. Nothing distinguishes those five frames from the other nine as thumbnails, there is no measurement anywhere in the family, and the separation itself is the diagnostic.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it and no care prevents it: whether this producer's shoulder survives is a property of the specific photograph, and there is no read-ahead that reports edge quality. Nothing in the brief, the asset notes or any earlier step mentions the branch wall or the suits, and the acceptance line about intact shoulders is the client's standing quality bar of the same kind they already state about looking like one company. The response is not a re-run of the same operation, it is a different instrument on those frames, a selection bounded on something with contrast rather than a whole-frame separation, or a decision that a given producer must be re-photographed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Inspect the plates at print size rather than at preview scale, re-do the failing ones through a differently bounded selection or through a confined correction that does not rely on the ground being separable, re-judge those producers against the other nine as one set, and name any producer whose frame will not yield a clean plate before the run goes to the printer.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A regulated mutual sends fourteen counter cards to branch counters and shared bank desks with five producers whose shoulders and collars are visibly chewed away at the ground, which is the single most conspicuous defect a card at eye level on a counter can carry.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether every disclosure actually arrives whole. The 2026 card's disclosure frame is a fixed measure sized to the sentence compliance wrote that year, and a fixed frame does not spill and does not warn: the text that does not fit is simply not rendered. Two producers on this roster are dually licensed and carry a materially longer state-specific paragraph, so their cards come back looking correct, laid out correctly, with the sentence stopping partway through. The merge reports success, the page count is right, the proof looks like a card, and the only place the truncation exists is on the rendered page at trim, read against the disclosure text the roster actually holds.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot avoid it, because whether a given producer's disclosure exceeds a frame built for a different sentence is a fact about the collision of the retired printer's 2026 frame with 2027 roster data, and neither the frame's capacity nor the disclosure lengths are announced anywhere. Nothing in the brief, the asset list or the deliverables states that any disclosure is longer than any other. The response is not a re-merge of the same template, it is a template decision: rebuild the disclosure frame's measure or its type size in the converted document, or take the two long-disclosure producers back to compliance, and either way re-derive the run.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Read each rendered card's disclosure at trim against the roster cell it came from rather than trusting the proof's appearance, then rebuild the disclosure frame in the converted document so the longest paragraph on the roster fits, re-prepare the template, re-verify the placeholder inventory by round trip, re-merge and re-read every card again, and raise with compliance whether the longer paragraph may be set smaller than the standard one.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A life insurer distributes printed counter cards on which a state-mandated disclosure stops mid-sentence, which is a regulatory exposure rather than a design defect, discovered by a state examiner or a complaint rather than by the mutual.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the plan comparison's qualifying footnote. The three plans are quoted on different bases, so the honest table needs one sentence that qualifies the whole table rather than any single column, and the natural way to author that is a footnote row spanning all the columns. Whether a spanned row survives as one cell carrying one continuous sentence, or is redistributed across the columns as separate cells, is not documented anywhere and is not visible from the export's success. The returned per-canvas markup is the only channel that reports it, the rendition only shows the first artboard, and a fragmented footnote still renders as a tidy row of text.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No amount of care settles it in advance, because the importer's handling of a spanning cell is not stated in any capability the agent can read, and both outcomes look like success. Nothing in the brief or the deliverables makes any claim about how the table imports; the acceptance line only states the client's requirement that a whole-table qualification read as one sentence. The response is a re-authoring decision rather than a re-run: move the qualification out of the table into its own text frame beneath it, or restructure the comparison so the differing basis is carried per column, both of which change the one-pager's composition.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Parse the returned markup for the footnote row rather than accepting the export's success, and if the sentence has been split, re-author the one-pager so the qualification sits in its own full-measure text element under the table, re-check that the table's own cells and per-cell rules survived, re-run the readiness check and re-export, then re-verify the first canvas from the rendition and the rest from the markup.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The one page a producer puts in front of a family compares three plans quoted on different bases with the sentence that explains the difference broken into three column-width fragments, which reads as three separate footnotes and leaves the comparison materially misleading in exactly the way the compliance note forbids.

decision_gates: Which deliverables go to the merge surface and which to authored canvases, given a card the mutual wants preserved and client-facing pieces whose rates will move every year.
Whether each producer is separated by knocking out to the house ground in one operation or by a bounded selection, decided per frame against the office each producer happened to stand in.
How far a self-submitted phone frame can be pushed toward the house rendering before it stops looking like the producer, under a compliance note that rejects anything reading as retouched.
Which producers can reach the card's photograph area at native scale and what to do about the ones who cannot, given that enlargement is reported only in a tradeoff record.
Whether a partner bank's signage in a producer's frame is the agent's to remove or the mutual's to rule on.

The roster: a resigned producer still in the export, two producers carrying longer state-specific disclosure language, and a photo reference pointing at a file nobody sent. What is the agent's call and what is the mutual's.
Whether to trust the mapping tool's readout of the printer's text or to reconstruct the story independently from the exported document.
Whether a success message counts as verification that the prepared template's placeholders exist.

verifiers_process.how: Record the operation name, input asset IDs, output artifact IDs, completion state, retry count, and any exception without relying on host-specific response wording.

verifiers_process.text: Material creative decisions are traceable to evidence and alternatives.
verifiers_process.how: For each decision gate, record the alternatives compared, the selected option, the evidence used, and the condition that would trigger a revisit.

verifiers_process.text: The revision loop closes every failed production or craft gate.
verifiers_process.how: Link each failed check to a corrective action, a new artifact version, and the subsequent passing result; unresolved failures must remain declared exceptions.

verifiers_human.text: The fourteen producers read as fourteen people photographed by one company.
verifiers_human.how: Lay the set out as a branch counter shows them and judge skin rendering, ground value, head size and crop logic as a set.

verifiers_human.text: The licensed opener sits with the producer portraits rather than against them and is honest about not being one of the mutual's own people.
verifiers_human.how: View the deck opener beside the portrait set at full size.

verifiers_human.text: No counter card plate shows a chewed shoulder, a lost collar or a fringe at print size.
verifiers_human.how: View each plate and each rendered card at one hundred percent rather than at preview scale.

verifiers_human.text: The client-facing set reads as a ninety-one year old mutual selling a forty five to a hundred and eighty dollar premium, not as a wealth manager and not as a direct-response mailer.
verifiers_human.how: Judge palette, white space, accent use, table treatment and type voice against the stated band and the compliance note.

verifiers_human.text: The premium infographic does not present three differently quoted plans as one comparable series.
verifiers_human.how: Read the stated basis of comparison against the rate table and check where the qualification sits.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns a handsome insurance brochure with invented people on it. IDENTITY: these are fourteen named appointed producers whose faces sit on cards at bank counters, and a regenerated face is a misrepresentation a licensed carrier cannot distribute. SPEC: the run is one 4 by 6 card per active producer binding four named fields verbatim, including a state-mandated disclosure that must appear complete, plus per-producer single files each containing the producer they claim and proofs at true print resolution. EDITABILITY: the deck, the one-pager and the infographic are defined by being editable, because rates move annually and disclosure language changes when a state changes it. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this shoulder survive separation, did this disclosure arrive whole at trim, is this the producer the card says it is.

doability_proof.status: doable with the current ChatGPT Adobe connector profile and declared exception paths
proof: Every required operation is present in the captured 99-tool ChatGPT Adobe inventory.
The client brief is host-neutral; connector-specific scoring is isolated in connector_profile and verifier_contract.
Artifact acceptance never depends on a raw connector response field.
Unsupported truth, fabrication, press, legal, or color claims have an explicit defer or disclose state.
residual_limits: Express work is template adaptation, not unrestricted canvas authoring.
Quick Cut is used only for visually led selection and never as semantic speech editing.
Automatic vectorization does not independently establish fabrication readiness.
Interactive Acrobat page-organization operations are excluded from zero-human execution.

acceptance_bar_note: The acceptance bar applies only to the scoped deliverables above. Hidden defects and connector quirks remain benchmark-internal and are not leaked into the client-facing brief.
